title: SHRESHTA Scheme: Empowering SC Students through Quality Education:
summary: Schemes — SHRESHTA Scheme: Empowering SC Students through Quality Education:

items: o Objective: Provide residential education for Scheduled Castes (SC) students.
o Eligibility: Annual family income up to Rs 2.5 lakh; admission for class 9 and 11.
o Selection: National-level test by NTA.
o Benefits: Free accommodation, food, scholarships, and educational support.
o Launched: December 2021/June 2022 by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.
